questions.question: How many changes to utilities' large-load rules does the warehouse hold for October 2026?
questions.answer: The warehouse holds 32 large-load rule changes with an event date in October 2026 (utility_large_load_rule_changes, model-extracted from utilities' and regulators' documents). The table has 94 rows in all, and only 4 more were held back for licensing. The same table gives 15 for August, 25 for September and 22 for November 1-13. Months are UTC calendar months.
